items.topic: One skill, not nine, for reindexing
items.claim: Plan had 9 pi skills (collect, add, rewrite, distill, gates, agent-docs-sync, projects, release, analyze)
items.fact: Operator rejected 9 skills as too many; agent collapsed to a single router skill judo-catalog (SKILL.md + scripts/ + references/). Later the operator asked to split again for reuse (see next item).
items.evidence: session 2026-11-03T14:19:09Z, operator: '9 skills are too much 1 enough for the reindexing!'

items.topic: No subagents, agents, prompts, commands or flows; pi skills only
items.claim: 6 .claude/agents analyzers and 4 .claude/commands were to be ported as pi agents/prompts
items.fact: Plan uses only pi skills. Analyzer knowledge becomes skill references/ (model, backend, frontend, specs, authoring); the model analyses in its own session. docwriter skill is replaced by pi's skill-creator. No .pi/agents, no .pi/prompts, no flows.

items.topic: Drop GraphQL from blueprints; generate Mermaid via CLI
items.claim: Blueprints embed judo-cli GraphQL detection queries and mutations (~1,169 lines in model-blueprints/*/model.md)
items.fact: GraphQL is no longer needed. Each blueprint and best-practice structure diagram is generated by the CLI (judo-cli mermaid model --scope <package>) after building the shape in a copy of the Sandbox model, instead of hand-written; CI re-renders and fails on diffs.
items.evidence: session 2026-11-03T14:30:17Z, operator: 'Clean it up, we don't need GraphQL anymore, we need a way to generate the Mermaid with the CLI for each blueprint and best-practice.'

items.claim: No doc of CLI mermaid diagram generation
items.fact: judo-model-cli (develop, merged 2026-10-14, change add-mermaid-model-diagrams, MermaidCommand.java, util/MermaidFormatter, EsmClassDiagram) has `mermaid model [--scope <fqn>] [--depth n] [--split aggregate|package|none] [--kinds entity,enum,transfer,actor,operation] [--members types|names|none] [--md]` drawing the IN-MEMORY model incl. unsaved edits; and `mermaid from <file|->` converting saved query/graphql JSON (works without daemon). Also `query esm <Type> --mermaid` / `graphql '<q>' --mermaid`. Arrows: composition `*--`, aggregation `o--`, association `-->`, generalization `<|--`, mappings `..>` 'maps', multiplicities shown; only classDiagram (no state/sequence). Warns when a diagram exceeds render limits: narrow with --scope, --split aggregate, --members none.

items.claim: Hand-written classDiagrams validated by own parser and 'expect' lists
items.fact: recipes/<id>.yaml (outside catalog) = ordered CLI create/update/fill steps in one package; renderer copies Sandbox.model, runs steps, `validate --strict`, `mermaid model --scope <pkg>`, writes between `<!-- mermaid:generated recipe=<id> cli=<ver> -->` markers, discards. Best practices without model shape declare `recipe: none: <reason>`. State/sequence diagrams stay hand-written (CI checks they parse).
items.evidence: session 2026-11-03T14:40Z, agent plan; operator approved 'Ok that is fine'

items.claim: Recipes/CLI steps could appear in blueprints
items.fact: Blueprints and best practices contain ONLY Mermaid and descriptions, never CLI syntax or GraphQL; CLI steps live in recipes outside the catalog root. Use new CLI capabilities in tooling.
items.evidence: session 2026-11-03T14:56:19Z, operator: 'Check new cli capabilities we will use those! NO cli in the blueprints! keep this in mind only mermaid and descriptions!'

items.topic: Reusable skill split and pi package
items.fact: Repo becomes a pi package exporting reusable skills: judo-blueprint (consume/apply, pin-source), judo-model-mermaid (recipe render/check, diagram own model scope), judo-blueprint-author (add/rewrite entry), judo-session-distill (any project's sessions -> redacted candidates); plus internal judo-catalog-maintain (sweep, rewrite batch, agent-docs sync, check-all, release). Consumers pin one tag for kb git source (pin: v<version>, subdir=catalog root) and `pi install git:...@<tag>`. pi package manifest: package.json `pi.skills` paths.
items.evidence: session 2026-11-03T14:32:42Z operator: 'make it reusable! split the skills and list those that could be removed'

items.fact: Remove (kept at tag archive/pre-kb-restructure): 4 .claude/commands, 6 .claude/agents, docwriter skill, scoring scripts and `score` field (replace with evidence+status), GraphQL in 105 model.md, CONVENTIONS.md, test-blueprint-mutations.sh, tracked judo-cli.jar (pom download to target/), agent-docs/domain/ copies, both PROGRESS.md (use PROJECTS.md swept-SHA column), query-catalog.py (kb_search + frontmatter tags), manage-flows, .obsidian, legacy/, memory-mine script. Non-catalog dirs: recipes/, skills/, tests/, openspec/, .pi/ excluded from kb indexing.

items.topic: Overlapping consumer skills shadow packaged ones
items.fact: pi keeps the first skill when names collide, so local copies in consumer projects shadow packaged skills. rackinspect: judo-blueprint, judo-model-cli-mutations (GraphQL docs, superseded by CLI --help/--schema), judo-backend/frontend/model/deployment/e2e-testing/integration-testing-docs (duplicate agent-docs), judo-agent-docs-gap. mlszksz: .claude/skills/judo-cli and cli-tester belong in the CLI repo.

rackinspect project MEMORY.md (1.8 MB, §-separated sections built via memory_add) is not read by distill-session-knowledge (JSONL only). Content is mostly rackinspect-specific/personal (dev preferences, md-document-converter pandoc 3.9.x traps, .pi/bin/judo-cli wrapper, KB hygiene, AGENTS.md gitignore trap, openspec validate --strict failing in 53 of 101 repo specs). Ignore 60+ .MEMORY.md.recovery-*/.retired-* snapshots. Decision: drop memory-mine script, mention MEMORY.md as optional reference; spec says distill ignores memory.
items.evidence: session 2026-11-03T14:31Z, agent answer to operator 'what is memory mine?'

items.fact: Model-authoring change (add-model-authoring-wizards): `create -t <Type> --in <fqn> --set k=v [--index|--before|--after] [--schema [field]] [--dry-run] [--json] [--brief]`; `update <fqn>` and `delete <fqn>` positional (-f/--fqn hidden, deprecated); `delete --cascade` (--force alias); `move <fqn> --index n | --before/--after`; moveUp/moveDown removed (GraphQL: move(fqn:, input:{index:})); `--set a,b` sets list, "" empty string, null rejected; `fill <transfer>`; `--dry-run` creates, reports, undoes. Also commands merge, split, relocate, transform, status, save, discard, validate.

.pi/skills/model-reconstruction rebuilds a Designer .model via CLI only and compares: recon.sh seed|describe|compare|plan (needs target/judo-model-cli-*-standalone.jar, javac). Differences are classified cli-defect or not-expressible. Reference read only through describe; save after each part.
